name: Brigade Eternia
description: A large community of 1,124 apartments across 12 towers in Yelahanka, planned around a central courtyard. A 35,000 sq.ft clubhouse anchors the site, with play areas and cobbled paths through the landscape.
curation: Homes arranged around a central courtyard
Short drive to Bagmane Sierra and The Galleria Mall
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
photoDescription: Clubhouse building in front of residential towers
